nodes.name: audioparam.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the AudioParam DOM interface representing an audio parameter with scheduled value changes, ramps, curves, and automation-rate control.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust DOM binding using reflect_dom_object pattern with Servo's DOM infrastructure for Web API implementation.

nodes.summary: Audio parameter with scheduled automation methods for ramps, curves, and precise timing of value changes.

nodes.summary: Schedules a discrete value change at a specific time on the audio timeline.

nodes.summary: Schedules a linear ramp from the current value to a target value at a specified time.

nodes.summary: Schedules an exponential approach to a target value starting at a specified time.

nodes.summary: Cancels all scheduled parameter changes starting at a specified time.

nodes.summary: Cancels scheduled parameter changes and holds the current value at a specified time.
